subject: design-technology

moments.title: Stereolithography patented
moments.body: Hull invents a process for curing liquid resin layer by layer with UV light, founding 3D Systems.
moments.takeaway: Additive manufacturing began as a rapid prototyping tool.

moments.title: RepRap project
moments.body: Bowyer's open-source project aims for a 3D printer that can print its own parts. It democratises desktop 3D printing.
moments.takeaway: Open hardware shaped the consumer 3D printing market.

moments.title: Tempe house 3D-printed
moments.body: Concrete 3D printers begin producing low-cost housing in Mexico and the US.
moments.takeaway: Additive manufacturing scales from desktop to architecture.

now.title: 3D printing now
now.body: Industrial 3D printing is used for aerospace parts, dental implants and bespoke prosthetics. Consumer printers are widespread but rarely transformative.
now.open_questions: Which manufacturing will additive replace, and which will it leave alone?

reflection: A 40-year-old technology is still finding its right scale.
